purpose.en: Stretch the outer hip and the side of your waist.

text.zh: 腿交叉在后，髋向外推，身体向椅子侧弯
text.en: Cross the leg behind, push that hip out and lean toward the chair

text.zh: 一手扶椅背，另一只手臂举过头顶
text.en: Hold the backrest with one hand and reach the other arm overhead.

text.zh: 膝盖微屈，拉伸感出现就停住呼吸
text.en: Keep your knees soft and hold where you feel the stretch.

commonErrors.en: Putting all your weight on the chair.

cautions.zh: 髋或腰部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your hip or back hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
